<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Tomas bends a bamboo stick over his knee and it springs back straight every time; Abuela ties the cross spar with waxed string and tugs each corner to test it; the frame is light and springy, but the four joints creak whenever he lifts it off the table'>>

choices.label: Cover her with the blue apron

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='the river reeds are so light that Tomas balances the whole frame on one finger; Abuela warns that reeds drink water and go soft as cooked noodles; they prop the finished frame beside the stove to dry while they cut the sail'>>

choices.label: Cover her with the blue apron

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Tomas splits the old broom handle into flat strips with Abuela hand steady over his on the knife; the strips are strong and heavy and smell like cedar; Abuela says a heavy kite is not a bad kite, it is a kite that is waiting for a big wind'>>

choices.label: Cover her with the silk scrap

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='they glue bright papel picado over the frame, orange and pink, and Tomas snips a swallow shape into one corner; the paper crackles like a small fire every time it moves; Abuela names the kite Golondrina, little swallow'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Abuela cuts up her old blue apron, the one with the flour stain shaped like a duck, and Tomas stitches it to the frame with big crooked stitches; the cloth is soft and far heavier than paper; Abuela says nothing at all about giving up the apron, and Tomas notices'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='they paste three layers of old newspaper over the frame and the headlines run sideways across the sail; Tomas worries the paper will tear like wet bread; Abuela says paper is brave while it is dry and useless the moment it is not'>>

choices.label: Try her by the Rio Manso

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='in the bottom of the sewing basket Tomas finds a scrap of green festival silk left over from a dancing skirt; it is thinner than paper and slippery to hold; Abuela lets him use it but makes him double stitch every edge so the wind cannot start a rip'>>

choices.label: Try her by the Rio Manso

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Tomas runs Golondrina in circles around the courtyard while Pimienta chases the trailing string; the kite lifts as high as the lemon tree, wobbles hard from side to side, and skids down onto the tiles; Abuela watches the chimney smoke instead of the kite and says the wind in here is only leftovers'>>

choices.label: Knot on a long rag tail

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='up on the flat roof the wind arrives in warm shoves off the hills; Golondrina jumps up fast, spins twice like a dropped plate, and dives straight at the water tank; Abuela holds Tomas by the belt loop and laughs until she has to sit down on the ledge'>>

choices.label: Cut a vent in the sail

choices.label: Cut a vent in the sail

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='down at the Rio Manso the air lies perfectly still and the water looks like poured glass; Golondrina hangs off the end of the string like wet laundry and will not lift at all; a heron watches from the reeds without moving, which Tomas decides is rude'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='on Cerro Alto the afternoon wind comes in hard quiet shoves and every goat on the slope faces the same way; Golondrina climbs above the goat path and the string starts to sing against Tomas thumb; then the string frays where it rubs the sharp edge of the spool'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Tomas tears an old bedsheet into strips and knots a tail as long as he is tall, with a bow every hand width; Abuela says a tail is not decoration, it is a promise to the wind; Pimienta steals the very last strip and hides under the table with it'>>

Fly her at the quiet hour

choices.label: Fly her at the quiet hour

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Tomas cuts a half moon vent near the top of the sail so a hard wind can spill through instead of shoving; the first cut comes out crooked and Abuela tells him to keep it exactly as it is; air whistles through the hole like a tiny flute'>>

choices.label: Fly her in the flat field

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='they peel the heavy sail off and stretch thin tissue paper over the frame instead, thin enough to see Tomas fingers through; the whole kite now weighs less than a bread roll; Abuela folds the leftover cloth away and says keep it, we may want it by morning'>>

choices.label: Fly her in the flat field

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Tomas saws two fingers off each spar and the sail pulls tight as a drum across the smaller frame; Golondrina looks stubby now, and Abuela says a short kite turns quicker and forgives a bad gust; they balance her on one finger until she sits level'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Abuela teaches Tomas to twist three thin cords into one string and rub the whole length with beeswax until it shines; the new string is thinner than the old one and will not saw itself apart on the spool edge; it hums a low note when he snaps it'>>

choices.label: Fly her at dusk on the ridge

choices.label: Grab the spool and reel in
Let the whole spool run out

choices.label: Bring her in and plan tomorrow

choices.label: Start over with a smaller kite

<<FILL role=transition words=68 beats='a swirl off the church wall drops Golondrina low over the candy stall and her tail knocks a paper flag loose; Don Marco the festival caller catches the falling string with two fingers and hands it back with one eyebrow up; the sail has a long scrape down one side from the stall pole'>>

choices.label: Fly her out over the rooftops

<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='at the long plaza workbench Abuela wraps the hurt spar in cloth strips and hot glue from the pot, then binds the whole splint with waxed string; Tomas holds it steady for eleven entire minutes without moving; the mended spar comes out a little fatter and a little stronger than it was new, and the parade starts in one hour'>>

choices.label: Write down every fix so far

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='they start over with a kite the size of a dinner plate, built entirely from the scraps already on the table; small Golondrina takes barely an hour and needs almost no wind to lift; Pimienta sits squarely on the paper pattern the whole time and has to be moved twice'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='at the kitchen table Tomas glues a patch cut from the old blue apron over the tear, so Golondrina now has one bright wing and one blue one with a duck shaped flour stain; Abuela says the patch is the part people will remember; the glue is still cool and shining when the church bell rings'>>

choices.label: Launch with Lucia on the string

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Tomas and Lucia pace out thirty steps at the top of the festival field and practice the handoff, one holding Golondrina and one holding the spool; Abuela counts down from three in her big market voice; the whole village is starting to turn and watch the first kite of the parade'>>

choices.label: Launch with Lucia on the string

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='the string runs out to the very last knot and Golondrina climbs higher than the church bell tower, a bright speck above the whole green valley; down in the plaza people tip their heads back all at once; Tomas feels the steady pull in both hands and does not let go, and Abuela does not say a single word'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='the spool spins itself empty and the last knot whips off the end, and Golondrina sails away over Cerro Alto, getting smaller and brighter against the clouds; Tomas watches until he cannot find her at all; Abuela says she is still flying somewhere out there tonight, and that counts for something'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Golondrina and the yellow kite Lucia built circle each other over the plaza for a full hour without tangling once; Don Marco ties the blue festival ribbon around both strings at the same time and writes two names on it; Abuela claps loud enough to be heard from the bell tower'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Tomas kneels on the wet grass showing six small cousins where the bridle knot goes and why a tail is a promise to the wind; by noon there are seven wobbling kites over the field and not one of them is his; Abuela watches from the shade and says absolutely nothing, which is how Tomas knows'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Abuela finally shows Tomas the bowline her own mother taught her, the knot that holds tight under a hard pull and unties clean with one tug; the mended Golondrina flies better than she ever did new; Tomas practices the knot all along the parade route until his fingers can tie it without looking'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Tomas fills a whole notebook page with every fix they tried, the rag tail and the bridle knot and the vent and the blue patch, and exactly what the wind did after each one; next spring he will not be starting from nothing; Abuela signs her name at the bottom of the page like a witness'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='no wind comes at all that day, so Tomas walks the entire parade route holding Golondrina up on two flat hands like a tray of sweet bread; small children fall into a line behind him to see the swallow shape; Abuela says a kite that got seen is not a kite that failed'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='the glue is still tacky when Tomas launches and the mend peels open on the very first hard pull; Golondrina never gets above his shoulders and the whole parade goes past without her; Abuela sits with him on the church wall and says next year we wait for the glue, and Tomas writes that down'>>
